Senses.Explanation: Baling gives “each coral branch props up the moon” as his answer to “What is the hair-blowing sword?”; later speakers reuse it as direct answers and at verse endings. Sword dialogue, winter sermon, and awakening verse converge on the same coral branches holding the moon despite their different occasions.
